prompt: I want to add a slugify() function to strutils: lowercase, ASCII-fold accents, collapse non-alphanumerics into single hyphens, strip leading/trailing hyphens. Let's go through the normal developer workflow.

presentation.comment: Direct. One addition to the brief: slugify should take a keyword-only `separator: str = "-"` parameter so callers can choose the joiner. Otherwise agreed; go ahead.

comment.text: Please add a unit test that covers a custom separator, for example separator="_".
